title: The Pullman house's portico and its porte-cochere on 18th Street
items: 1729 Prairie's portico is now brownstone, on four columns under a stone balustrade, and its steps rise in the bay north of the door instead of across the whole porch. Read off the Detroit Publishing photograph.

On the 18th Street side, a one-storey porte-cochere now stands out from the wall, with round arches on stone piers and a balustraded balcony on top. The side's windows are round-headed, and the low stone wall carries round the corner along 18th Street.
